mapper.select: SELECT delivery_id, request_id, address_vault_token, locale, parameters, status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_notification_delivery WHERE request_id IN #{id} ORDER BY request_id, delivery_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification_delivery (delivery_id, request_id, address_vault_token, locale, parameters, status, attempt_count, next_retry_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{deliveryId}, #{requestId}, #{addressVaultToken}, #{locale}, #{parameters}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
